items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Chris Kelly, did you hear him?

ctx.x: Now everything, see we haven't got, you don't find no individuals of the day. It's a copy of the day. See, no individuals, players of the day. You take the old guys, they didn't copy. Lyle had his style. Arnold Mottweiler, he had his style. See? Freddie had his style. Joan Pendleton had his style. Wiley had his style. Now when they come along with Buddy Petitian, Buddy had his style. Rainey, Rainey, Kid Rainey, he had his style.
Chris Kelly, did you hear him?

Well, all them guys had his style. Sam Morgan. Sam Morgan. They had his style. They had a different, they stayed in his style. See? You could be outside and hear that trumpet playing, I don't care, for blocks away, you could tell, well that's Sam, that's Sam Morgan's band, you could tell him what he's style, see? But today, everybody's trying to copy behind the other fella, you don't know who's style. Hey, you want to sit over here, wait and rest? No, no.
